whyWeExist.title: Why Safetools Exists
whyWeExist.story: A few years ago, someone close to us used an online utility platform for personal documents. Months later, that data appeared online. That incident exposed a hidden problem across the internet: many utility platforms collect, store, or process sensitive user files on remote servers without transparency.
whyWeExist.mission: Safetools was created to change that.
whyWeExist.solution: Most modern tools do not need your files uploaded to external servers. That is why Safetools is built around a privacy-first architecture where processing happens directly on your device whenever possible.
